title: Laboratory policy: ten seeds
summary: Predefine ten distinct seeds per configuration. Record failures and retries, separate training seeds from data/split seeds, and freeze the protocol before execution.
interpretation: The demo mechanically implements this policy. A model decision cannot reduce the required number of seeds.
limitations: This is not a universal conference rule and does not guarantee statistical adequacy. Deterministic or theoretical studies require a non-applicability justification; the MVP runner supports only stochastic methods.
